regression.scope: All tests/core and tests/core-ideals test files except field-conformance.test.ts, which is run separately after refreshing evidence.

classification.scope: Selected-context classification and exact native recovery; no down-projection or row enforcement claim

projection.scope: Authored availability projection and ideal receipt recovery; no row execution claim

fieldGate.scope: Qualified Field ideal gate; native evidence retained and fingerprint-checked, not rerun by this command

delivery.scope: Published Field binding subsets only; not general native-language conformance

limits: Omitted value members become Spark null under the explicit schema; this is not a general JSON omission/null equivalence.
No availability rule is generated for absent-allowed/unspecified; this does not validate unrelated constraints.
Without a routing column, native mixed-context generation applies the most restrictive constraint globally.
Raw null context and normalized empty map produce different native rules.
The pinned generator does not escape quoted context values for Spark SQL; the native engine refuses that rule.
String row-condition API is deprecated in GX 1.15.1; later GX versions are not claimed.
A metadata-exact projection is qualified to its selected runtime/checked-schema profile; it is not native concept replacement or general row execution equivalence.
Native classification interprets exact declared booleans only; coercions/defaults and unknown refinements remain residual or blocked.
Existing context scope and authored intent cannot be silently overwritten.
Other source members, namespaces, properties and extensions outside single-Field projection receive explicit residuals; strict mode blocks loss.
Core 0.3.0 and Nullability remain experimental; one binding does not satisfy the two-system ideal admission gate or the five-system delivery gate.
